title: Estimation and Placebo-Testing Rates with Quasi-Stayers in Three-Wave Panels
banked_reason: The matching estimation and testing rates are proved only for highly structured Gaussian subclasses with baseline independence, a globally constant sign-mixture parameter, and either exact product small-ball laws or a narrowly prescribed sparse density geometry.
proof_attempt_summary: The run established matched estimation and honest scalar-testing rates for product and fixed sparse Gaussian subclasses, plus explicit fixed-count obstruction witnesses for dependent baselines. A bounded D0 repair added the constructive estimator and witness lemmas required by the math panel; the final D0.5 math and decision reviews both passed with no findings. The broader dependent-baseline placebo upper and testing frontiers, arbitrary-index coverage, and adaptation remain open, leaving the delivered contribution at incremental tier below the field floor.
tldr: The product and sparse three-wave subclasses have matching estimation and honest scalar placebo-testing rates, now supported by explicit data-only split-sample estimator bounds and finite Gaussian comparison certificates. In the twice-smooth ordinary design their main-effect cancellation elbow is \(|a|\asymp n^{-1/10}\); the product and sparse placebo elbows are \(|a|\asymp n^{-1/15}\) and \(|a|\asymp n^{-3/20}\). The deterministic Lipschitz envelope gives \(|\theta|\le L\). Combined with the positive constant lower bound on the dependent known-index class supplied by explicit fixed-count triangular-array witnesses with \(\bar e=1\) and \(q_J(h,k;x)=hk\), this yields an exact \(\Theta(1)\) main-target frontier there and on the full adaptive union. The dependent placebo risk and scalar separation retain lower bounds \(c\{n^{-2/5}+|a|\}\) on that known-index class and positive constant lower bounds on the adaptive union; matching placebo procedures, general-index coverage, and restricted-regime adaptation remain open. No ambient-open or perturbation-stable robustness of the fixed-count witnesses is claimed.
gap: The 2024 WAOSS paper conjectures a slower three-wave placebo but does not determine how joint support, conditional signed cancellation and scalar test power interact. Existing thin-set results assume positive ambient density and known weights.
fill: Establish a signed two-component minimax and honest-testing frontier in product and sparse causal designs, then characterize oracle and adaptive dependent-baseline limits without assuming their equality.
